gaps.sentence: The talks fell ___ when neither side would compromise on fishing rights.
gaps.explanation: 'Fall through' = (a plan or deal) fail to be completed.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
This old house needs doing ___ before winter.
gaps.explanation: do up = repair and decorate a building. (British usage)

gaps.sentence: When the alarm sounded, everyone made ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.explanation: 'Make for' = move towards, usually in haste.

gaps.sentence: I've mixed ___ the twins' names again.
gaps.explanation: mix up = confuse one thing/person with another.

gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.
